Historical tax-allocation illustration

La Verne’s 2018 application lists potential new-development assessed value and participant shares. These inputs illustrate one annual allocation; they do not reproduce its phased forecast or establish current borrowing capacity. Edited values are your scenario assumptions.

Source: La Verne 2018 application, printed pages 7–8. Net revenue for debt, yield, DSCR, repayment term and closing deductions: NR.

The ZIP includes a standalone JavaScript module for annual allocation, level-debt screening and funding incompatibility checks. It supplies no invented financial assumptions.

Open an item to read all fields, sources and limitations. Downloaded CSV retains the exact requested columns.

Evidence grades: A · causal LA; B · causal same intervention elsewhere; C · association or related intervention; D · vendor, advocacy or expert estimate. A quality-of-life result does not establish a home-price coefficient. Endpoint metadata is distinct from validated feature coverage.
